# ghost/fdroid

F-Droid: search the FOSS catalogue, read an app's page, browse a category, list installed apps. Read-only; never installs.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/fdroid
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/fdroid search_apps --device <serial> --param query=<query>
ghost skill run ghost/fdroid open_app_page --device <serial> --param package=<package>
ghost skill run ghost/fdroid list_installed_apps --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/fdroid browse_category --device <serial> --param category=<category>
```

## Actions

- `search_apps`: Find a markdown editor on F-Droid
- `open_app_page`: Show me the F-Droid page for Markor
- `list_installed_apps`: Which of my apps came from F-Droid?
- `browse_category`: Show me F-Droid's browser apps
